6000.1010:
"Battle is a matter of vital importance to the Great Mage.  It is the realm
 of life and death, and lies upon the road to ultimate success or utter ruin."
6000.1020:
"The use of magic must be thoroughly studied.  Be wary of the Mage who
 wields this ominous weapon without due reflection."
6000.1030:
"The strategies of battle must be thoroughly studied.  Pity those that
 follow the Mage who has not given this due consideration."
6000.1040:
"When an army resides at home, it must answer to the will of its kin.  Once
 in the field, the army is governed by the laws of its leader."
6000.1050:
"When the objectives of a Mage are in harmony with the will of his
 followers, all commands will be obeyed without fear of mortal peril."
6000.1060:
"The Great Mage evaluates the conditions of terrain before deploying his
 forces.  Only then can the proper number and type of followers be directed
 to an objective."
6000.1070:
"If a Mage is not courageous, then doubt will overwhelm him and drive great
 plans from his mind."
6000.1080:
"Properly led followers celebrate the attack, and are resentful when
 ordered away from battle."
6000.1090:
"The Great Mage feigns weakness, and hoards resources for the correct
 opportunity."
6000.1100:
"The Great Mage lures the enemy into traps, and draws opponents away from
 the true objective."
6000.1110:
"The plans of an enemy can be revealed in his actions.  If he is a
 Great Mage, then his followers will act with deception."
6000.1120:
"Any battle may be won with the correct approach.  The Great Mage exploits
 the weakness in his enemy, while avoiding the strengths."
6000.1130:
"Arrogance and anger are the bane of all Mages.  When these are encouraged,
 a Mage will attack without proper planning."
6000.1140:
"Sporadic attacks can frustrate the opponent.  This sort of badgering will
 wear upon his patience, and distract him from his plans."
6000.1150:
"No amount of planning can save the Mage who is unable to respond to
 unforeseen circumstances."
6000.1160:
"The Mage who does not recognize inherent dangers to his followers does not
 recognize the correct way to use them."
6000.1170:
"The wasteful Mage does not recognize which resources are needed.  He
 occupies himself with inferior pursuits, and permits the enemy to act."
6000.1180: "That which can not be acquired freely may be taken from the enemy."
6000.1190: "There is no satisfaction for the Mage who desires more than enough."
6000.1200:
"Any Mage may defend against chance.  Unforeseen events exploit only those
 circumstances which are permitted to exist."
6000.1210:
"The Mage who leaves nothing to chance will rarely act with error, but he
 will also rarely act."
6000.1220:
"The Great Mage dwells upon what fate has conceded to him, rather than what
 it has denied."
6000.1230: "Even a blind Mage can see opportunity if he looks close enough."
6000.1240:
"With a prudent strategy, the Great Mage creates more opportunities than he
 finds."
6000.1250:
"Fate deserves the greatest acclaim.  A victory loses its wonder when simple
 planning is given credit."
6000.1260:
"Idle comfort permits a Mage to reflect upon his world, yet the heat of
 battle forces him to examine his own nature."
6000.1270: "The Mage who has never known failure may be crushed with a single defeat."
6000.1280: "Experience has no value when its lessons are ignored."

9210.11: The kingdom of Doegan, once a powerful nation, teeters on the brink of decay.
9210.12: In the Doegan Capital resides Patric Fulgirth, a slothful ruler who disregards the needs of his people.
9210.13: This derelict leader should topple quite easily...
9210.21: The kingdom of Doegan is ruled by Gim Blacktongue, a crafty mage who claimed the throne by way of treachery.
9210.22: Though the land prospers under this new sovereign, an air of distrust permeates the Doegan Capital.
9210.23: The people cry out for this stench to be cleared...
9210.31: The kingdom of Doegan prospers under the steadfast rule of Hariah Highkin.
9210.32: Its borders are strong, its people are content, and the Doegan Capital is a model of prosperity.
9210.33: Victory will be achieved here at a terrible cost...
9210.111: Winding deep within the untamed hills is a river, both dark and mysterious.
9210.112: It ends within the Serpent Valley, where notorious bandits recover between raids.
9210.113: Even now, Wenda Wildeye musters forces for another foray.
9210.114: There can be no more rest for this unjust mage...
9210.121: The Serpent Valley is crossed by a winding river, and lies deep within the untamed hills.
9210.122: Few dare to endure the rigorous life there, yet Haden Stonehand calls this place home.
9210.123: You must test the mettle of this hardy opponent...
9210.131: Only the hardiest souls inhabit the Serpent Valley, where mere survival is the greatest concern.
9210.132: It is here that Newt Longscar disciplines an army in preparation for your imminent arrival.
9210.133: Your only hope may be to strike at once, before they are fully prepared...
9210.211: Atop the high mountains lie the destitute ruins of a once mighty city.
9210.212: The streets of Old Stone Keep are now barren, save for a mob led by Ebon Lefash.
9210.213: These greedy scavengers must learn to respect what is rightfully yours...
9210.221: The ruined city of Old Stone Keep is rumored to house secrets of the arcane arts.
9210.222: Shandra Mystahr has grown obsessed with this legend, and marches here in search of the prize.
9210.223: This may be your best opportunity to ambush your wary opponent...
9210.231: You capture an enemy scout near Old Stone Keep, and acquire vital information.
9210.232: You learn that a dangerous mage called Turik Dumark plans to ambush you on the road.
9210.233: It is remarkable how quickly the hunter becomes the prey...
9210.311: A squatter named Sean Mulhaven camps near Herne's Wood, and harasses all who would pass.
9210.312: When you demand that this mage cease this activity, he bombards you with callous insults.
9210.313: Clearly, this rogue must be taught some manners...
9210.321: Though you are cautioned by the locals to steer clear of Herne's Wood, you find it necessary to encamp at its edge.
9210.322: Without warning, a mage called Darah Thorne advances on your position, and demands a tribute for your stay.
9210.323: You are left no option but to quash this rude intrusion...
9210.331: From a wandering Bard you hear of Tyranis Shagal, a great mage who lays claim to Herne's Wood.
9210.332: You are impressed by the achievements of this leader, and resolve to issue a challenge.
9210.333: After all, the greatest glory is won from only the most worthy of opponents...
9210.411: Your leisurely trek through the Web Mountains is suddenly blocked by Olgala Zug.
9210.412: This impudent mage claims ownership of the pass, and demands a toll in exchange for your crossing.
9210.413: You prepare to make payment in a manner which will not soon be forgotten...
9210.421: Your Southern guard warns of an approaching army which seeks to profit from your ongoing campaign.
9210.422: Dawn MacDare is said to orchestrate this scheme from a camp in the Web Mountains.
9210.423: You decide to teach them, by example, the grim folly of their plan...
9210.431: Your followers are tormented by harassing attacks led by a mage named Anson Darkeye.
9210.432: You pursue this antagonist into the Web Mountains, where you quickly lose your way.
9210.433: With your deceptive opponent closing in, the dire nature of your plight becomes all too clear...
9210.511: Timmis Taern presides over Edenvale Castle, yet this proud ruler lacks tactical skill.
9210.512: By way of a simple ruse, you lure him into the field, where the castle walls can offer no protection.
9210.513: A simple end awaits this simpleton...
9210.521: The ruler of Edenvale has passed from this world, leaving no heir to inherit the throne.
9210.522: With haste, you march upon Edenvale Castle, only to find that Madja Djiid contests your claim.
9210.523: This opportunity must not be snatched from your grasp...
9210.531: You engage in prolonged conflict with a rival named Deliah DeGuerre.
9210.532: Both of your armies need reinforcement, and with this goal in mind, you race one another to Edenvale Castle.
9210.533: Somehow you are certain that this rivalry will soon meet its end...
9210.611: All seaborne merchants must pay tariffs imposed by Dumar Sturmarik.
9210.612: This greedy tyrant is so absorbed with his practice, that you manage to infiltrate the Realm of Tides.
9210.613: It should require little effort to scuttle this empire...
9210.621: The followers of Shari Lightfoot are respected for their mobility.
9210.622: When you corner them on the shores of the Great Sea, they swiftly retreat to the Realm of Tides.
9210.623: If only your agile foes could foresee the trap into which they have been chased...
9210.631: A strong adversary named Drago Dreadloch gains support by way of the Great Sea.
9210.632: Seizing an unexpected opportunity, you manage to establish a foothold within the Realm of Tides.
9210.633: When this storm settles, only one mage shall rule over the waters...
9210.711: In every village surrounding the Realm of Lands, you hear complaints of a wandering ruffian.
9210.712: Each time that Galen Addakal storms into town, few escape without injury.
9210.713: Protests turn to praise, as you vow to punish this brash bully...
9210.721: Wyrin Bloodclaw is said to be skilled in the hunt, both of man and of beast.
9210.722: You learn that this mage has been set on your trail, which has brought you to the Realm of Lands.
9210.723: There is only one method to shake this dread wolf...
9210.731: None are more familiar with the strategic value of terrain than Brigitte Bannal.
9210.732: This mage rules over the Realm of Lands, where nature has become a fortress.
9210.733: You will need all of the wits you can muster to penetrate these defenses...
9210.811: It is widely believed that the Realm of Fire is ruled by a ferocious tyrant.
9210.812: In truth, you discover, the mage who resides there is Amber Vikdotter, an infamous fraud.
9210.813: It is time to expose this pathetic sham...
9210.821: You encounter a group of peasants who have abandoned their homes in fear of rumblings within the Realm of Fire.
9210.822: This distressing activity is clearly the work of Fegg Gnash, who conducts raids from that underground kingdom.
9210.823: The time has come to extinguish this mercenary practice...
9210.831: Raven Remahr is a fearless mage who has settled within the Realm of Fire.
9210.832: In this blazing place there burns a powerful flame, which none have ever mastered.
9210.833: You can not permit your opponent to tame this mighty inferno...
9210.911: The festival of Talos held in the city of Konigheim has somehow gone awry.
9210.912: A great blaze has begun in the center of town, and quickly spreads to neighboring structures.
9210.913: You determine that the true cause of this disaster is a fiend named Illnar Dreth.
9210.914: Though the city may be lost, you resolve to punish the demented arsonist...
9210.921: You take lodge in Konigheim for a well deserved rest, only to be awakened by a shower of fire.
9210.922: A frantic watchman identifies Gareth Gimorrin as the cause of this calamity.
9210.923: It is clear that this mage wishes to bring your campaign to a fiery end...
9210.931: A benevolent order led by Saja Stillwater watches over the city of Konigheim.
9210.932: These most worthy opponents are nearly invincible while sheltered within the Keep.
9210.933: By chance, a disastrous fire draws them into the city, permitting you to penetrate their defenses...
9210.1011: Stivanu Pantel is obsessed with all manner of games.
9210.1012: This mage squanders many a day within the Puzzle Palace, neglecting friends, home and trade.
9210.1013: The reality of your intentions will not escape this hedonist...
9210.1021: You are pursuing Kala Danirith through a mountain tunnel, when the surrounding passage suddenly gives way.
9210.1022: You find yourself within the Puzzle Palace, a maze believed to be only a legend.
9210.1023: From the darkness, your former prey swears of the fate that awaits you...
9210.1031: Venar Orknal is a mage who pursues a campaign identical to your own.
9210.1032: After outwitting one another for months, you agree to a contest of skills within the Puzzle Palace.
9210.1033: The loser of this match shall forever concede any claim to the realm...
9210.1111: You stumble upon a remarkable town where no device properly functions.
9210.1112: The residents claim to have purchased their wares from a swindler called Moro Mitedigger.
9210.1113: You quickly set out for the Hall of Wonder to put an end to this shoddy affair...
9210.1121: Dwarven smiths are rarely seen outside of their lairs, yet you encounter such a group hiding in the foothills.
9210.1122: With unrestrained rage they curse the name of Willem Warblade, who has driven them away from their workshop.
9210.1123: You quickly set out for the Hall of Wonder with a plan to evict this intruder...
9210.1131: A mighty inventor named Eldura Moreen labors without rest in the Hall of Wonder.
9210.1132: This tireless mage plans to unlock the mystery which is the essence of the Bloodforge.
9210.1133: None should discover the secret of that which the gods themselves have created...
9210.1211: When a mage is rumored to have great skill, upstarts frequently issue a challenge.
9210.1212: As you pass through the streets of Vanesci Hamlet, a local named Hjerik Broadkin provokes you into a duel.
9210.1213: Such a challenge made in public simply can not be ignored...
9210.1221: Your followers collapse at the edge of Vanesci Hamlet, overjoyed at the prospect of filling their grumbling bellies.
9210.1222: The villagers insist that, to spare their town, they have promised their food to a brigand named Niro Longtooth.
9210.1223: You see a way to satisfy all who are present, and form a plan to surprise this oppressor...
9210.1231: Jessa Hearthe wields considerable influence in most every political circle.
9210.1232: Though retired for years in Vanesci Hamlet, this lady still manipulates grande affairs.
9210.1233: When your campaign is denounced by this popular mage, you have no choice but to regain your honor...
9210.1311: Your followers are scattered by Wulfgang Warts, who chases them into the hills.
9210.1312: They lead their pursuer to the Phantom Pass, where you have instructed them to rally.
9210.1313: For you have just recently discovered that this most capable opponent has a crippling fear of such places...
9210.1321: Your forces are surrounded by a mysterious fog while crossing the high mountains.
9210.1322: When the misty shroud lifts, you find yourselves in the mythical Phantom Pass.
9210.1323: The angry voice of Korr Odahn calls out to you, making promises of your grisly fate...
9210.1331: You hear the haunting tale of Moria Chantel, who is said to capture travelers near the Phantom Pass.
9210.1332: These poor victims are rumored to be used in a ceremony which grants immortality to the evil mage.
9210.1333: Timing your arrival to meet the needs of your dark foe, you masquerade as suitable prey...
9210.1411: Never before had you believed that you would take sympathy upon a Goblin.
9210.1412: Yet in the Kingdom of Nix they are enslaved by Wurt DuMire, and forced to labor within a distant mine.
9210.1413: Though unsure of what power encourages you to act, you vow to stop this foul operation...
9210.1421: You are appointed as an emissary to negotiate peace with the Goblin King.
9210.1422: While holding council in the Kingdom of Nix, an ambassador named Adan Longstride slanders your good will.
9210.1423: Goblin tradition states that to settle this dispute, you must engage in a trial by combat...
9210.1431: The mountains tremble with the terrible news that the Goblin King has been slain.
9210.1432: This disaster has attracted suspicious outsiders, including Ibin Stormrider, a dangerous opportunist.
9210.1433: In the Kingdom of Nix you prepare to chase off this aggressor, so that a Goblin can lay claim to the throne...

9310.5: WELCOME TO THE FORGOTTEN REALMS, APPRENTICE.
9310.10: YOU MUST LEARN THE WAYS OF BLOODFORGE AND BATTLE IF YOU ARE TO AMOUNT TO ANYTHING HERE.
9310.15: I WILL GUIDE YOU THROUGH A TRAINING GROUND WHERE YOU CAN PRACTICE THE BASICS OF LEADERSHIP.
9310.20: YOU CAN ALSO USE THE ? cursor AND encyclopedia TO LEARN MORE ABOUT GAME FEATURES.
9310.25: FEEL FREE TO EXPERIMENT, BUT DON'T ATTACK THE PEASANT OR HIS HOME (WE WILL NEED THEM LATER).
9310.30: YOU WILL BEGIN THIS TUTORIAL WITH A bloodforge AND 2 basal golems.
9310.35: THE BASAL GOLEMS GATHER YOUR SPELL POWER, WHICH WE LOCALS CALL mana.
9310.40: YOU CAN SELECT A GOLEM, THEN transfer ITS STORE OF MANA TO YOUR BLOODFORGE.
9310.45: WHEN YOU HAVE AT LEAST 40 mana, YOU CAN SELECT YOUR BLOODFORGE AND CREATE MORE BASAL GOLEMS.
9310.50: YOUR FIRST GOAL IS TO HAVE 6 total golems UNDER YOUR CONTROL.
9310.55: SELECT THE victory conditions BUTTON IF YOU WANT ME TO REPEAT THESE INSTRUCTIONS.
9310.105: YOU CONTROL 6 BASAL GOLEMS!  YOU NOW HAVE A STRONG POWER BASE TO SUPPORT YOUR CAMPAIGN.
9310.110: YOUR NEXT ORDER OF BUSINESS IS TO EXPLORE THIS REGION USING YOUR BASAL GOLEMS.
9310.115: TO DO THIS, MOVE YOUR GOLEMS INTO UNEXPLORED TERRITORY BY SELECTING DESTINATIONS IN EITHER THE action window OR ON THE level map.
9310.120: EVENTUALLY, YOU WILL DISCOVER THAT YOUR PROGRESS IS BLOCKED BY AN AQUEDUCT FILLED WITH WATER.
9310.125: I WILL ADD TO THIS MAP A MAGICAL ITEM WHICH PERMITS TRAVEL ACROSS WATER.
9310.130: WE'LL MEET AGAIN WHEN ONE OF YOUR FOLLOWERS picks up this item.
9310.205: ONE OF YOUR FOLLOWERS HAS PICKED UP THE DRIFT DISC!  ANY WALKING CREATURE MAY CROSS OVER WATER IF IT IS CARRYING THE DISC.
9310.210: BEYOND THE AQUEDUCT THERE SHOULD BE A FRIENDLY TEMPLE.
9310.215: MOVE A BASAL GOLEM NEXT TO THE TEMPLE, THEN SELECT ITS transform OPTION.
9310.220: IF YOU HAVE AT LEAST 25 mana, THEN YOU CAN CHOOSE THE cleric portrait TO TRANSFORM YOUR GOLEM INTO A CLERIC.
9310.225: YOU MUST create a cleric BEFORE YOU CAN MOVE ON TO THE NEXT TASK.
9310.405: YOU HAVE CREATED A CLERIC!  THIS FOLLOWER CAN HEAL MOST FLESH AND BLOOD CREATURES.
9310.410: SOMEWHERE IN THIS REGION, THERE SHOULD BE A PEASANT WHO HAS BEEN ASSAULTED BY UNRULY WARRIORS.
9310.415: HE IS WOUNDED, AND HIS HOME HAS BEEN DAMAGED IN THE ATTACK.
9310.420: YOUR NEXT GOAL IS TWO-FOLD... YOU MUST heal the peasant USING YOUR CLERIC, AND YOU MUST find the item WHICH WILL REPAIR THE DAMAGED STRUCTURE.
9310.425: I WILL NOW ADD THE NECESSARY ITEM TO THE MAP.
9310.430: WHEN THE PEASANT IS HEALED TO FULL HIT POINTS AND HIS HOME IS REPAIRED, THEN WE CAN DEAL WITH THE ASSAILANTS.
9310.505: THE PEASANT AND HIS HOME ARE SAVED!  NOW TO DEAL WITH THOSE NASTY WARRIORS.
9310.510: YOUR ENEMY IS FORTIFIED BEHIND THE GREAT WALL IN THE NORTHWEST CORNER OF THE MAP.
9310.515: FLYING CREATURES CAN PASS OVER THIS WALL, SO YOU WILL NEED A MYSTICAL SITE WHICH PROVIDES THESE.
9310.520: THERE SHOULD BE AN EMPTY FOUNDATION NEAR YOUR BLOODFORGE WHERE SUCH A STRUCTURE MAY BE CREATED.
9310.525: IF THERE IS ALREADY A MYSTICAL SITE THERE, THEN IT WILL REVERT TO A FOUNDATION WHEN YOU DESTROY IT.
9310.530: fill all four spaces OF AN empty foundation WITH BASAL GOLEMS, THEN CHOOSE THE transform OPTION.
9310.535: SELECT THE crypt portrait TO TRANSFORM YOUR GOLEMS INTO A CRYPT.
9310.540: I'LL TELL YOU WHAT COMES NEXT AFTER YOU HAVE created a crypt.
9310.605: YOU HAVE CREATED A CRYPT!  NOW LET'S OBTAIN FLYING CREATURES.
9310.610: VARIOUS ACHIEVEMENTS IN THE GAME PROVIDE YOU WITH experience, WHICH IS MONITORED IN THE UPPER RIGHT CORNER OF YOUR SCREEN.
9310.615: THIS EXPERIENCE CAN BE USED TO RESEARCH NEW TRANSFORMATION OPTIONS.
9310.620: YOU SHOULD HAVE EARNED ENOUGH EXPERIENCE BY NOW TO RESEARCH THE GARGOYLE OPTION.
9310.625: SELECT THE research BUTTON TO ACTIVATE THE RESEARCH MENU, THEN CHOOSE THE gargoyle option FROM THE MENU.
9310.630: THIS MIGHT TAKE SOME TIME, BUT I'LL BE HERE WHEN YOU FINISH.
9310.705: YOU HAVE RESEARCHED GARGOYLES!  NOW SEND YOUR BASAL GOLEMS TO YOUR CRYPT AND TRANSFORM THEM INTO GARGOYLES, JUST LIKE YOU DID WITH THE CLERIC.
9310.710: YOU SHOULD LEAVE SOME FOLLOWERS IN GOLEM FORM TO CONTINUE GENERATING MANA.
9310.715: WHEN YOU HAVE A FEW GARGOYLES, MOVE THEM PAST THE GREAT WALL AND SEARCH OUT THE ENEMY WARRIORS.
9310.720: YOU WILL FIND THAT THEIR LEADER CONTROLS A BARRACKS, WHICH HE USES TO CREATE HIS WARRIORS.
9310.725: YOUR ENEMY WILL BE VANQUISHED WHEN his barracks is destroyed!
9310.805: THE ENEMY BARRACKS IS DESTROYED!  YOU NOW POSSESS THE FUNDAMENTAL SKILLS FOR BECOMING A GREAT LEADER.
9310.810: YOU WILL DO WELL TO create basal golems AND gather mana EARLY...
9310.815: ..explore the map WHEN POSSIBLE, AND collect magic items BEFORE YOUR ENEMY CAN OBTAIN THEM...
9310.820: ..TRANSFORM YOUR BASAL GOLEMS INTO higher level creatures WHICH SUPPORT YOUR OVERALL STRATEGY...
9310.825: ..create mystical sites AND research transformation OPTIONS TO EXPAND YOUR CAPABILITIES...
9310.830: ..AND USE BOTH items AND spells WHERE THEY ARE MOST NEEDED.
9310.835: FARE THEE WELL IN THE FORTHCOMING CONFLICTS, AND REMEMBER THE ? cursor AND encyclopedia... THESE HOLD THE CLUES TO THE GRANDEST OF STRATEGIES!
